report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency (62-78ms); one 344ms sample is a single outlier. Metrics show zero 502s and no dependency errors. No evidence establishes a fault; the alert may reflect a transient outlier. Insufficient current evidence to bound any taxonomy cause, so hand off for baseline and downstream latency data.
